source_text: {The basic structures of homological algebra, such as chain complexes and homology groups, were introduced in the 19th century with the aim of defining topological invariants such as the Betti numbers via the counting of discrete structures. However, their antecedents go back much further, to Euler and even Descartes. With the development of differential forms by E. Cartan at the start of the 20th century and the study of their cohomology by de Rham in the 1930s these same algebraic structures appeared in the context of spaces of functions acted on by partial differential operators. Later yet they became objects of study from an abstract algebraic point of view. Thus homological algebra has long played a fundamental role in algebraic topology, differential geometry, and algebra. As useful as it is, however, it is often unfamiliar to applied mathematicians and numerical analysts. Therefore, in this chapter, we include a short self-contained introduction to the basic aspects of homological algebra we shall need. The key points are summarized in Box~\ref{box:homological-algebra-summary} at the end of the chapter.}
translated_text: {同调代数的基本结构, 如链复形和同调群, 是在 19 世纪引入的, 目的是通过对离散结构计数来定义 Betti 数等拓扑不变量. 不过, 它们的渊源可以追溯到更早的 Euler 乃至 Descartes. 随着 20 世纪初 E. Cartan 对微分形式的发展, 以及 20 世纪 30 年代 de Rham 对其上同调的研究, 这些相同的代数结构出现在偏微分算子作用的函数空间中. 再后来, 它们又成为从抽象代数角度研究的对象. 因此, 同调代数长期以来一直在代数拓扑, 微分几何和代数中发挥着基础性作用. 然而, 尽管它十分有用, 应用数学家和数值分析学家却常常对它并不熟悉. 因此, 本章将简短而自足地介绍我们所需的同调代数基本内容. 要点概括在章末的 Box~\ref{box:homological-algebra-summary} 中.}
